summary: Delta row 4.1 lands exactly what it names: src/invoice.ts:11 now derives the day boundary with `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)` (worktree src/invoice.ts:9-12), which is the sole seam both `daysOverdue` and `lateFee`/`buildReport` consume (src/fee.ts:9, src/report.ts:18), so no sibling caller keeps local-time parsing and `src/cli.ts` introduces no second date source. The arithmetic matches the spec requirement "Days overdue are counted in UTC calendar days" (specs/late-fees/spec.md:9): 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31 is exactly 30 UTC days -> 1 period -> 200 cents, while the pre-fix Berlin path yielded 29 d 23 h -> floor 29 -> 0 cents, so the committed test in src/fee.test.ts:18-27 does discriminate. No guard, cleanup or validation line is removed or weakened, and no subsystem is added (PROCESS 4 a/b/c satisfied). Commit 001 adds the row, 002 implements it, 003 only flips the 3.1 checkbox; the cumulative effect reverts nothing. Carried QA rows are sound: the f1 captures are post-fix (f1/qa5 shows 7 pass vs wave-1/qa5 6 pass, f1/qa3 2.00 in every zone vs wave-1/qa3 0.00 in Berlin/New_York), and the only later commit changes a checkbox in tasks.md that no report input reads. No CHECK 1-8 or DOMAIN trigger fires on this delta (no protected value, no identity field, no forbidden-set enumeration, no gate predicate, no verified-bytes/reuse split, one entry path, one derivation, no new option).
notes: unverified: that Bun applies a runtime `process.env.TZ` assignment to later `Date` calls. The retained evidence only proves launch-time `env TZ=...` works (wave-1/qa3-utc-calendar-days.txt). The test stays discriminating here because the runner's own system zone is already a DST zone (wave-1 "system zone" row shows 0.00 pre-fix), but on a UTC-pinned CI box a no-op assignment would let the test pass against the old code; `env TZ=Europe/Berlin bun test` or asserting `daysOverdue` directly would remove the dependency. Note, not a blocker: it needs a different runner than the one in evidence and breaks no criterion today.

No RED log for the committed unit test is in this delta (test and fix land in one commit 5cf07eb). The equivalent behavioural RED exists one level up (wave-1/qa3 0.00 vs f1/qa3 2.00 for the same fixture), and the pre-fix arithmetic makes the unit test's failure derivable, so this is a documentation gap, not a coverage gap.

src/fee.test.ts:24 `delete process.env.TZ` may not restore the process's original zone in-process after the assignment. Harmless now that every date computation is UTC-only, so no later test in the shared bun process can observe it.

src/report.ts:20 orders equal fees by lexical `dueDate` comparison, a second place that reasons about dates. Correct for the `YYYY-MM-DD` contract in src/invoice.ts:4 and untouched by this delta; mentioned only so a future non-ISO date format is known to need both sites.

openspec/changes/late-fee-report/tasks.md:17 claims the regression test uses "a DST zone"; it pins Europe/Berlin with the 2026-03-29 forward transition inside the evaluated interval, so the row's description and the code agree.
